tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: Deepest ground: footer, page edges, the band under a hero. Dark value is the forest floor of the brand photo.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Default page background.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, panels, the estimate form. Dark value is the Linktree page color exactly.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Input fills, hover rows, selected chips.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body copy on surface-000 through surface-300 (11.5:1 or better in both themes). Dark value is the Linktree cream text exactly.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary copy, captions, helper text on surface-000 through surface-300 (5.9:1 or better). Sampled from the fog in the brand photo.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: card borders, dividers, table rules. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges that carry meaning: input borders, outline-button borders on plain surfaces (3.2:1 or better on every surface).

tokens.name: pine
tokens.usage: The brand green. Same in both themes: header bars, footer, the hero band, dark blocks in light layouts.

tokens.name: on-pine
tokens.usage: Text and outlines on pine, on scrim-photo and on glass (13.6:1 on pine).

tokens.name: mist
tokens.usage: Fog. Decorative bands, illustration fills, the cover slab. Not for text.

tokens.name: lichen
tokens.usage: Accent fill for the single primary action per view (Get a free estimate). Muted take on the website's chartreuse; olive in the light theme.

tokens.name: on-lichen
tokens.usage: Text on lichen fills (9.4:1 dark, 6.5:1 light).

tokens.name: lichen-text
tokens.usage: Accent text: links, eyebrows, active nav, prices, on surface-000 through surface-300 (5.9:1 or better).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus outline with 2px offset on every interactive element; 5.9:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: scrim-photo
tokens.usage: Overlay on the fog-pines photo so on-pine text holds 4.5:1. Both themes: photos stay dark.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Fill of link tiles that sit on the photo, with blur-fog behind them (the Linktree look).

tokens.name: status-success
tokens.usage: Done / approved / scheduled. Text and icons on surfaces (5.8:1 or better). Rain blue, not green, so it never relies on red vs green; always with a word.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Pending / weather delay. Text and icons on surfaces; always with a word.

tokens.name: status-danger
tokens.usage: Errors, required-field messages, cancelled. Rust orange; text and icons on surfaces; always with a word.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card and panel headings, service page titles.

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: Replacement windows and doors installed by our own crews.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Get in touch for a free inspection and estimate.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Estimates are free and come with photos.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a heading, in lichen-text. Set text-transform: uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Badge padding, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between label and input; tile gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; button horizontal padding; mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between a heading block and its content.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section padding on mobile.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Section padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Hero top and bottom padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, inputs, small thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and link tiles (the Linktree's rounded-large).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, the photo frame.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills and the round logo badge.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Only for things that float: menus, dialogs, a sticky estimate bar. Cards use a line border instead.

tokens.name: blur-fog
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter blur behind glass tiles on the photo.
